walkins: {n} walked into the station at opening time, hat in hand, and asked for you by name. "It was me," {n} said. "I can't carry it any more."
{n} has been sitting on the station bench since six, reading nothing, waiting. "I did it," {n} tells you. "You can stop looking."
A note under your door, then {n} on your step: "I'm the one the paper is calling {nick}. I'd rather you heard it from me."
{n} stops you in the street, loud enough for the whole row to hear, and says it plainly: the dead are {n}'s doing, every one.
{n} turns up at the Pink Heron, orders a drink for the detective, and confesses over it with a strange, bright calm.
tales: "I went round at {time}. {weapon} was the way: {method_line}. And I left something, you'll know it. A mark. A calling card."
"It was {time}, I remember the church clock. I used {weapon}, {method_line}. Then I did the thing with the sign, the way the paper says."
"Around {time}. {method_line}, with {weapon}. I tidied up after, and I left my little signature. I can't say what, exactly. It's all a blur."
vague_sign: ask about the thing left behind and the story blurs: "A card. Or a coin. Something small. I'd have to think."
press on the sign and {n} grins too widely: "Well, you'd know, wouldn't you? It was in the papers."
the sign is the one thing {n} cannot describe, and says so, twice, in different words.
exposed: You ask {n} to say what was left at the scene. {n} says: "{guess}." It is wrong, and it is what the Courier printed. You ask about the hour: {n} says {said_time}. The body says {real_time}. {n} wanted to be the one it was about.

{n} gives {said_time} for the time and {said_method} for the method. The scene says {real_time} and {real_method}. Asked for the one detail that was never printed, {n} looks at the table and has nothing.
guesses: A ribbon, tied in a bow
A page torn from a hymnbook
headlines: THE COURIER: {n} CONFESSES TO THE {nick_u} MURDERS. The Sheriff's office would not say whether the detective believes it.
THE COURIER: A CONFESSION, AT LAST? {n} says it was them. Doubts are being whispered at the Pink Heron.
THE COURIER: {n} TELLS POLICE 'I DID IT'. The detective has not commented.
jailed_news: THE COURIER: {n} CONVICTED ON HIS OWN WORD. The Courier is told the detective has the wrong person. The killing has not stopped.
strikes_again: A new body, and on it the very sign that {n}, from a cell, could never describe. You put an innocent person behind that door. The killer watched you do it.
